title: Sync Interval Calculator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Clocks and Watches with AI
description: A Chart.js sawtooth chart of clock error over three days that grows between NTP syncs and resets at each sync, with drift and sync interval sliders and clock presets.

learningObjectives: Calculate the worst-case error for a drift rate and sync interval
Calculate the sync interval needed for a 1 second accuracy goal

keyQuestions: When does the largest error occur?
How often must a 30 ppm clock sync to stay within 1 s?
commonMisconceptions: A WiFi clock must sync every few minutes to be accurate
Error keeps growing even after a sync
assessmentOpportunities: Compute the worst-case error of a 50 ppm clock synced every 12 hours
Find the interval that keeps a 20 ppm clock within 0.5 s
